claims.text: Brazilian military UFO records have been transferred into the Arquivo Nacional and are publicly accessible.
Referenced by the board but no dossier written yet. This node exists so the graph resolves and so the gap is visible rather than silent — see the wave-3 queue.

connections.edgeLabel: The UFO fund is held in Brasília and its reference code says so
connections.label: Arquivo Nacional (Brazil) - UFO/UAP collection
connections.note: The Arquivo Nacional's own notice identifies the holding as 'o Fundo Objeto Voador Não Identificado – OVNI (BR DFANBSB ARX)', produced by the Comando da Aeronáutica and held by the Arquivo Nacional, comprising 743 registros. DFANBSB is the archival code for the Arquivo Nacional's Brasília unit. RQS 193/2022 states the transfer route directly: 'A partir de 2007, a Aeronáutica, mas não o Exército e nem a Marinha, passou a enviar seus papeis resultantes de suas pesquisas para o Arquivo Nacional, em Brasília.' [CORRECTED 14 Aug 2026: RQS 193/2022 is a request for a COMMEMORATIVE SPECIAL SESSION under Art. 199 RISF, approved 16 Mar 2022, held 24 Jun 2022 - not a records-seeking or compelling instrument. Its durable value is the content of its justificacao, which names Operacao Prato, the 1986 night, SIOANI and the archive reference BR DFANBSB ARX. These edges assert what the document NAMES, which is verifiable in its text and unaffected by its procedural nature, so the tier is unchanged. Any claim that the instrument COMPELLED disclosure would be false.]

desc: Brasilia is the seat of the Brazilian federal government and the administrative centre from which the Brazilian Air Force's unidentified aerial phenomena files were released into the Arquivo Nacional, making Brazil one of the few states to have placed military UFO records in a citizen-accessible public archive. The 1986 incident of 19 May, in which Brazilian Air Force fighters were scrambled against multiple radar-tracked objects and the Air Minister subsequently briefed the press, is the country's principal documented case and its records trace back through this capital. Brasilia functions on this board as the control case for what state transparency on this subject actually looks like when it is attempted.
